2610.08668.title: Semantic Behavioral Watermarking: Paraphrase-Robust and Forgery-Resistant Provenance for LLM Agents
2610.08668.paper_summary: Behavioral watermarking embeds an owner identifier in an LLM agent's high-level action choices, giving provenance without touching output tokens. Prior agent watermarks break in two ways. First, all three prior schemes bind the watermark to the exact action symbol, so renaming a tool desynchronizes decoding even when the observation is untouched; in AgentMark's own robustness test, paraphrasing the observation alone drops bit-recovery to 16.8%. Second, every prior agent watermark studies only removal: none asks whether an adversary can forge a trajectory that verifies as someone else's, a question answered affirmatively for text watermarks (Jovanović et al., 2024). We present Semantic Behavioral Watermarking (SBW): watermarking over semantic action clusters under history conditioning, with the public-cluster bin replaced by keyed collision-resistant binning whose fresh-bucket assignment is provably unpredictable in the random-oracle model. Across five agent models (3B-14B, four vendors) and three encoders the ordering holds on both benchmarks: on ToolBench (600 trajectories per model) detection under rewriting is 0.49-0.66 for cluster-level versus 0.05-0.17 for exact-symbol at a permutation-calibrated 1% FPR, at 72-83% choice agreement against 22-27% for logit biasing; on ALFWorld (100 episodes per model) it is 0.92-0.97 versus 0.00-0.01. Keyed binning takes adaptive forgery from 100% to the false-positive floor at the primary operating point (bge, r=64). We also mark the boundary that guarantee does not cover: when the adversary copies the victim's own steps, shuffled splicing is neutralized (0.000 on Qwen2.5-3B) but chained replay remains at 0.76-0.98 across the five models, reported as open. Paraphrase robustness costs about half of the per-step watermark capacity. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SBW-Agent-Watermark.
2610.08668.paper_summary_zh: 行為水印將擁有者識別碼嵌入LLM代理的高層次行動選擇中，提供來源而不觸及輸出標記。先前的代理水印有兩種破壞方式。首先，所有三種先前的方案將水印綁定到確切的行動符號，因此即使觀察未被觸及，重新命名工具也會使解碼不同步；在AgentMark自己的穩健性測試中，僅僅對觀察進行改述會使位元恢復率下降到16.8%。其次，每個先前的代理水印僅研究移除：沒有一個問題是對手是否可以偽造一條驗證為他人的軌跡，這個問題對於文本水印的回答是肯定的（Jovanović等，2024）。我們提出了語義行為水印（SBW）：在歷史條件下對語義行動集群進行水印，公共集群箱被替換為鍵控的抗碰撞箱，其新桶分配在隨機預言機模型中是可證明不可預測的。在五個代理模型（3B-14B，四個供應商）和三個編碼器上，排序在兩個基準上保持一致：在ToolBench（每個模型600條軌跡）中，重寫下的集群級檢測為0.49-0.66，而確切符號為0.05-0.17，對應於經過排列校準的1%假陽性率，在72-83%的選擇一致性對比於22-27%的邏輯偏見；在ALFWorld（每個模型100集）中，檢測率為0.92-0.97對比於0.00-0.01。鍵控分箱將自適應偽造從100%降低到主要操作點的假陽性底線（bge，r=64）。我們還標記了保證未涵蓋的邊界：當對手複製受害者自己的步驟時，隨機拼接被中和（在Qwen2.5-3B上為0.000），但鏈式重放在五個模型中仍保持在0.76-0.98，報告為開放。改述的穩健性約耗費每步水印容量的一半。代碼可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SBW-Agent-Watermark獲得。
